metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins that streamline the OpenCell developer workflow — from Jira ticket management and UI scaffolding to automated commits, pull requests, and code review. Jira and Confluence come from the official Atlassian plugin in Anthropic's claude-plugins-official marketplace; Figma, Playwright, Opencell, SonarQube and PostgreSQL ship here.

plugins.name: oc-fe-engineer
plugins.description: Expert React/TypeScript UI engineer sub-agent for building, refactoring, and architecting frontend components

plugins.name: oc-fe-reviewer
plugins.description: Frontend code reviewer sub-agent for validating React/TypeScript code against project standards

plugins.name: oc-fe-designer
plugins.description: Frontend designer sub-agent for translating Figma designs into implementation-ready React/MUI components with design tokens and styling

plugins.name: oc-fe-test-writer
plugins.description: Frontend test writer sub-agent and /oc-fe-write-tests command that write Vitest tests for changed React/TypeScript code (or specific files) following OpenCell Portal testing conventions

plugins.name: oc-fe-create-ui
plugins.description: Create UI page from JIRA ticket ID using the oc-fe-engineer sub-agent

plugins.name: oc-fe-fix-bug
plugins.description: Fix a bug from a JIRA ticket: update status, create fix branch, and start fixing

plugins.name: oc-fe-fix-pr
plugins.description: Fix the review remarks of a pull request: read its unresolved Bitbucket comments, fix them on the PR branch via oc-fe-engineer, then reply, resolve, and push

plugins.name: oc-fe-cypress-expert
plugins.description: Cypress testing expert sub-agent for end-to-end testing, test automation, and flaky test resolution

plugins.name: oc-fe-create-e2e-test
plugins.description: Create Playwright E2E tests from JIRA ticket requirements using the oc-fe-e2e-expert sub-agent

plugins.name: oc-be-tools
plugins.description: Backend development toolkit for Opencell Core — agents for building entities, services, APIs, tests, and Postman collections, guideline-loading skills, an implementation orchestrator (/oc-be-implement), and a guideline-based code review command (/oc-be-review)

plugins.name: oc-ar-tools
plugins.description: Archi design toolkit for Opencell Core — agents and skills for US analysis and technical design

plugins.name: oc-ar-ai-tools
plugins.description: Archi design toolkit for Opencell Core — agents and skills for US analysis and technical design dedicated to claude AI developpement

plugins.name: oc-cache-jira
plugins.description: Fetch and cache JIRA ticket data locally for use by other OpenCell commands

plugins.name: oc-commit
plugins.description: Commit changes using JIRA ticket ID and summary from cache with automatic code review

plugins.name: oc-pull-request
plugins.description: Push changes and create a pull request for a JIRA ticket with automatic squash and PR creation

plugins.name: oc-review-pr
plugins.description: Review a pull request linked to a JIRA ticket using the oc-fe-reviewer agent with a detailed report headed by the PR's Vitest test count, plus suggested fixes

plugins.name: oc-ai-report
plugins.description: Cross-ticket AI-usage report over a period — reads the AI-metrics JSON (backend/frontend/QA) from Jira, groups by area → date → user → ticket, and adds each ticket's original estimate, Tempo-logged time, and linked-bug count. Read-only; Atlassian MCP only

plugins.name: oc-time-report
plugins.description: Estimation-vs-logged-hours report over a period (independent of the AI-usage JSON) — Tempo-worklog driven, one row per developer x ticket with type, area (from the developer roster), title, Architect & Dev-lead estimates, logged hours, bug hours, time gain (without/with bugs) and child-bug count. Writes date-stamped HTML + CSV to ./docs/. Atlassian MCP + Tempo (TEMPO_API_TOKEN)

plugins.name: oc-figma-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to Figma MCP server to extract design context, generate code from designs, and retrieve design tokens

plugins.name: oc-playwright-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to Playwright MCP server to automate browser interactions, take screenshots, and test web applications

plugins.name: oc-opencell-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to the Opencell billing system via MCP to manage invoices, quotes, customers, payments, subscriptions, dunning, and all billing operations

plugins.name: oc-sonar-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to SonarQube MCP server to access code quality metrics, issues, and analysis results

plugins.name: oc-postgres-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to PostgreSQL via MCP for database health analysis, index tuning, query optimization, and safe SQL execution

plugins.name: oc-fn-tools
plugins.description: Functional/product toolkit for Opencell — Jira INTRD issue authoring (oc-fn-func-design), Confluence docs-space authoring (oc-fn-documentation), Playwright-driven Opencell Portal navigation & screenshots (oc-fn-portal), the design-first phased delivery methodology (oc-fn-project-management), branded slide-deck authoring & rendering with the Opencell Marp theme (oc-fn-decks), branded one-pager / note / brief authoring & PDF rendering (oc-fn-briefs), and GUI/screen design against the Opencell Figma design system (oc-fn-gui-design). Bundles a headless Playwright MCP server (oc-fn-playwright).
